blocks.title: Testing
blocks.text: Testing is the process of evaluating software to make sure it meets the requirements and works as expected. It follows a hierarchy that begins with small components and moves to the whole system, ending with user acceptance.

items: Unit testing: individual units tested in isolation.
System testing: the whole system tested.
Acceptance testing: users or clients decide if the software is ready.
